description: Call this when the user asks what AI at Work would cost for a specific number of employees (1-500). Returns the tier, per-seat price and total, with optional co-branding. It flags when ordering more seats would cost less, and shows the Executive Suite and Rollout Pack alternatives. Does not take an order.

coBranding.description: Optional. True to include the company co-branding fee (free at higher seat counts). Defaults to false.

seats.description: Number of seats to quote, as a whole number.

name: get_seat_quote
title: Seat Quote
